corpus_item: RI-MAG05 §A1 (the eight design-language rules), §A2 (the per-school emissive palette, BINDING), §A3 (the nine per-effect briefs)

what_is_implemented: the palette, the residue budget and the per-effect briefs as DATA, so the analyser and the art critic read the same numbers
residue as a simulation fact: every projectile and every volume leaves a residue record at its terminal position for 3,600 f@60, reported in getMagicState().residues
L6 as a simulation fact rather than a shader promise: the emissive intensity curve below is dim through startup and bright at release, and it is authored per class in `intensity_by_phase`
what_is_NOT_implemented: the meshes, particles, decals and shaders themselves. There is no spell VFX in the renderer in this piece.

therefore RI-MAG05 PART 2 (FIDELITY) is UNMEASURABLE in this build and scores 0, fail-closed (HARNESS §5). RI-MAG05 PART 1 (ART DIRECTION) is measurable only as far as a data file can be judged, which is not far.
declared_state.owner_of_the_gap: W1-14 (this piece) declares it rather than implying otherwise. A critic scoring magic.vfx.fidelity should score 0 and cite this block.

design_language.rule: Spells are matter, never abstract light. Fluids, spores, growths, insects, dust, rime, sap.
design_language.forbids: floating runes, arcane circles, glyph rings, generic sparkle motes, lens flares

design_language.rule: Everything is wet. Surface tension, beading, running, dripping, stringing. Sap is the master material.
Summons unfold, grow, or pull themselves out. bind_lesser takes ~40 f@60 to haul itself out of the water.
design_language.forbids: portal flash, dissolve-in, a puff of smoke and a creature

design_language.rule: Fire sticks and drips. It is burning resin. It pools where it lands and keeps burning there.
design_language.forbids: a fireball that vanishes on impact

design_language.rule: Nothing is symmetrical. AoE footprints are irregular blooms.
design_language.forbids: radial mandala decals, hexagonal wards, concentric rings

design_language.rule: The windup is dim; the release is bright. The SILHOUETTE is the telegraph and VFX is never a substitute for it.
design_language.forbids: charge-up glow as the readable tell
design_language.mechanised_as: intensity_by_phase below; peak startup luminance must be < 45% of peak active luminance

design_language.rule: Every spell leaves residue for 20-90 s. Char, rime, scorch, wet patch, spore bloom.
design_language.forbids: effects that leave the world untouched

design_language.rule: No school may use the hue a generic elemental palette would predict.
design_language.forbids: orange fire, cyan ice, gold holy, violet arcane, toxic green

intensity_by_phase.note: Normalised emissive intensity, sampled at phase 0 (frame 1), 1 (last startup frame), 2 (last active frame), 3 (last frame). L6 requires max(startup) < 0.45 x max(active).

sorcery_marshfire.idea: Burning sap-resin. Sticks, drips, pools, keeps burning where it pooled. Never #FF6600.

sorcery_saltrime.idea: Salt and stilled water. Crystal growth along surfaces, not a projectile of ice. Never cyan.

sorcery_wamasu_arc.idea: Violet-white strike, GREEN afterimage burned into the eye. The green is the tell and it is why this is not lightning.

sorcery_wither.idea: Rot accelerated. A visible fungal fruiting on whatever it touched.

root_speech.idea: Sap, wet, with real surface tension. It runs UPWARD along the body, against gravity. That single inversion carries the school.

warding.idea: Xanmeer gold. Carved-relief geometry made of settling dust, not of light. The only school permitted straight edges - and they are BROKEN edges.

veiling.idea: Mostly refraction and a thin swarm. If you can see it clearly, it has failed.

chroma_budget.rule: In any frame, <= 8% of non-sky pixels may exceed CIELAB C* = 45 (RI-VIS05 §C, inherited unchanged).
chroma_budget.note: The only number RI-MAG05 raises against VIS05, and it is raised by exactly six points, for eight frames.

per_effect_briefs.fire_damage: A gout of amber resin, thick enough to have weight, that STRINGS as it flies. On contact it clings, runs down the target's silhouette, and drips into a burning pool that outlives the cast by 60 s.
per_effect_briefs.shock_damage: A single violet-white strike with almost no travel presence, then a GREEN afterimage decaying over ~24 f@60. Arcs deterministically to standing water and wet chitin. Leaves scorch pits.
per_effect_briefs.frost_damage: Not a projectile. RIME GROWS across the target's surface, following its geometry, from the contact point outward over ~18 f@60. On water it spreads into a walkable plate.
per_effect_briefs.restore_health: Amber sap beads out of the GROUND and runs UP the caster's legs and body against gravity. Wet, slow, visible surface tension. It looks like being fed, not like being blessed.
per_effect_briefs.levitate: The single most easily ruined asset in the game. NO glow, no aura, no wings. The character's SHADOW detaches and stays on the ground where the feet left it, and a thin skirt of disturbed spore-dust hangs beneath them.
per_effect_briefs.invisibility: Not transparency - WETNESS. The silhouette becomes a refractive water-film that the marsh shows through, distorted. Legible if you are looking, which is what makes detect_life a real counter.
per_effect_briefs.paralyse: The target's own posture freezes mid-motion; a rime of grey fuzz blooms along the joints. Nothing is added to the air. The horror is that the animation stopped.
per_effect_briefs.soul_trap: A hair-fine amber thread from the target to the gem in your hand, taut, visibly under tension, THINNING as the target's health falls. When it snaps the gem is warm and slightly wet. This asset must make the player uncomfortable; it is xul-hesh.
per_effect_briefs.bind_lesser: Over ~40 f@60 the water bulges, something inside it takes shape, and it HAULS ITSELF OUT. It never appears. There is no flash at any point.
